changelog: THE LAST ACT IS NOT THE END. Act IV has two new bosses drawn from Revelation 9, and bringing down the Act IV boss now opens the field for one final fight. A UNIT REBALANCE: every rank adds 25% base HP and 10% attack; light units get faster at rank 3, heavy units tougher; ranged units reach further at rank 4; every unit gains an action at rank 5. The Heavy Tank now has two actions. Flanking adds +1 damage for every other ally beside the target, and weak units can no longer dent heavy armour alone. Rockets and the Ion Cannon pierce armour. Drones fly: tanks, attack dogs and artillery cannot hit them. Selecting a Bannerman shows its aura (1 tile, 2 at rank 5). SMARTER, FAIRER ENEMIES: the enemy reads the same damage forecast you do, so it flanks, sends its rockets at your armour, and never swings at what it cannot hurt. Skirmish enemies no longer pour out troops every turn: each acts from a table set by its commander type, with a reinforcement budget that grows through each act (Holdout and Survive keep coming). Elites and bosses keep their decks. DEPLOYMENT: your reserves deploy ring by ring before the fight, Auto or Manual, and your hand is dealt when you are done. Cards now have draw and discard piles with animations; One-Shots go to the discard, and a played card lands on its pile after it resolves. Card upgrades that the rebalance made pointless were reworked. Plus a broad phone pass: new plate buttons throughout, cleaner settings and menus, map and bars sized for phones, and many fixes.
